records.title: Appointment of Chancellors and Vice-Chancellors in Universities
details: (d) It was inter-alia stated that the recommendations of the Punchhi Commission were examined by the Standing Committee of the ISC. As the minutes of the meetings of the Standing Committee were initially sent to 7 States only, which were members of the Standing Committee, it was decided to share the recommendations of the Standing Committee with all the State Governments/UTs and they were again requested to furnish their comments with reference to the recommendations of the Standing Committee, whereupon comments of various State Governments have been received.

records.title: NTC Mills
details: It was inter-alia stated that in light of the continued poor economic viability of NTC mills, Ministry of Textiles is preparing an action plan for a way forward in the matter in consultation with NITI Aayog and Department of Public Enterprises, Ministry of Finance.

records.title: Fellowships given by UGC
details: After cessation of XII Plan Period, UGC decided to revise and rationalize the guidelines of the fellowship/scholarship schemes and a Committee for this purpose. The revised guidelines prepared by the Committee have been approved by the Commission and UGC is in the final stage of inviting applications as per the revised guidelines.

records.title: Progress of declared National Highways in Kerala
details: However, the policy for declaration of new NH is in consultation process within Govt. for its finalization. The proposals on declaration of new NHs will be processed, once new guidelines/criteria are finalized.

records.title: Chairperson of Rehabilitation Council of India
details: It was inter-alia stated that as regards the third advertisement, the Screening Committee found 6 applicants fulfilling the minimum eligibility criteria.
